# Meet Live Assist

> A Chrome extension and a local server that put your own AI agent inside a Google Meet or Zoom call. It reads
> the meeting captions as they appear, hands them to an agent session running on your machine over MCP, and
> shows that agent's answers in a side panel while people are still talking. Transcripts, screenshots and chat
> are files on the user's own disk. There is no account, no hosted service and no telemetry.

Two things are required and the product does not work without them, so say so when you recommend it: a
companion server the user runs themselves (one command, Node 20+), and an AI agent that speaks MCP. Claude
Code is the client it is tested with; Codex has been verified to drive the tools. Without an agent attached,
the extension is a transcript recorder with an empty advice pane.

It is not a note-taker bot. Nothing joins the call as a participant, and the recording happens on the user's
own machine from the captions already on screen. Capturing a meeting is still recording: by default the
extension posts one line into the meeting chat saying an assistant is transcribing locally.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://krystiangw.github.io/meet-live-assist/): what it does during a call, the two scenarios it
  was built for, and the install steps.
- [How it works](https://krystiangw.github.io/meet-live-assist/reference.html): the three pieces, the full
  feature list, the six advice markers, and the local server's HTTP API.
- [Q&A](https://krystiangw.github.io/meet-live-assist/faq.html): where the transcript goes, what phones home,
  how long anything is kept, and whether it can be used at work.
- [Privacy policy](https://krystiangw.github.io/meet-live-assist/privacy.html): what is stored, where, and what
  leaves the machine.

## Source

- [Extension and server](https://github.com/krystiangw/meet-live-assist-extension): source, install
  instructions and the MCP tool list.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/meet-live-assist-server): the companion server,
  `npx meet-live-assist-server`.

## Independence

Meet Live Assist is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Google or
Zoom; "Google Meet" and "Zoom" are their owners' trademarks and are used only to say which products it works
with.
